readings: Linking each income record through the member who brought it in to that member's major, show each college with its total income amount and what fraction of the total income that represents, without rounding.
queries:
SELECT
    major.college,
    SUM(income.amount) AS total_income,
    SUM(income.amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS fraction_of_total_income
FROM income
JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
GROUP BY major.college
